test_title: PYST 59: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 13 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

‘A + B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’,

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the father of B’,

‘A $ B’ means ‘A is the son of B’,

‘A % B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’,

‘A / B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’ and

‘A * B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

Which of the following means P is the Son's wife of T?

i. T / B – K * P + O

ii. T + K * P + B % O

iii. K * P + B % T + O

iv. P + T * K + B % O
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 A is
 
 

 Symbol
 +
 –
 $

 Meaning
 Mother
 Father
 Son
 Sister
 Wife
 Husband
 
 

 to B
 
 

**So, by checking each statement one by one:**

i. T / B – K * P + O → T is the wife of B who is the father of K who is the husband of P who is the mother of O. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dfa624cd0398416420c27a2841907beafd11511a07fa0a72dab76c85d8f6e08c.png] 

Here, P is the T's son's wife or daughter-in-law.

ii. T + K * P + B % O → T is the mother of K who is the husband of P who is the mother of B who is the sister of O. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ade50787cab31822a28f37196a1a58651222459b15fccce87d5c68ccb3b82436.png] 

Here, P is the T's son's wife or daughter-in-law.

iii. K * P + B % T + O → K is the husband of P who is the mother of B who is the sister of T who is the mother of O. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0bf3cb41a6ceb02a36e89c6cf57269bdf6c029792a991d6f384d5daf3683ab7.png] 

Here, P is T's mother.

iv. P + T * K + B % O → P is the mother of T who is the husband of K who is the mother of B who is the sister of O. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/695d80ec3d17dc1f565d351ff350efdd602cfc9f09658bc51a28b90d30ec5364.png] 

Here, P is T's mother.

Thus, statements (i) and (ii) means P is the Son's wife of T.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"
